sentences.text: Anjura Khatun & Ors vs Unknown on 13 February, 2024
Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak

C.R.M. (A) 484 of 2024 13.02.2024 DL-79 Court No.29 In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of (AD) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with (Allowed) Harishchandrapur Police Station Case No. 877 of 2023 dated 20.08.2023 under Sections 498A/304(B)/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and subsequently charge sheet submitted vide Charge Sheet No.1055/2023 dated 18.11.2023 under Sections 498(A)/306/304(B)/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (G.R. Case No.2664 of 2023).
And In the matter of: Anjura Khatun & Ors.
....petitioners.
Mr. Sourav Mukherjee ...for the petitioners.
Petitioners before us stand on the same footing as that of the other co-accuseds who were granted the same facility by our order dated January 31, 2024 passed in CRM(A) 5267 of 2023.
Post-mortem report of the victim suggests that the victim died due to hanging.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a Bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each, with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default, the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
The prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
